title: Edgible card
description: Source of truth for a shareable pattern. A valid card has no device name, device id, hostname, organization id, password, or volume data.

name.description: Name of the card, the same as its directory.

type.description: app: one self-hosted app, the building block, always tested. pattern: several apps wired together for a purpose, built from app cards.

data.description: Optional. What the card's volumes hold, how to copy them consistently, and how to tell the data is there. It comes before places:, which test-card --write-places rewrites. card.env is always data and needs no entry.

volumes.description: One entry per named volume in the card's Compose files.

fingerprint.description: Required when a volume is irreplaceable. Run in service, read-only and quick, it prints one line of JSON: counts (integers) and dates (ISO), never content, such as {"bookmarks": 412, "latest": "2026-10-14"}. An empty install prints zeros.

places.description: Optional. For each place: the minimum recommended machine, and for a place no app uses, the Compose files it runs. Keys are place names.

name.description: Application name. Copied from metadata.name of edgible application export.

what.description: What this program is. Two apps that are one process say so here.

from.description: Image name, or for an app in a native place, the release it installs, such as https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.4. An existing-app export does not record it. Read it from docker ps by matching the port. No device and no organization.

database.description: Database image in the same Compose file, when the program does not run alone.

port.description: Host port. Copied from the workload containerPort of the export.

protocol.description: https for web apps. tcp or udp for apps that are not web, such as a game server or SSH; those have no auth mode, so authModes is [none], and their port is from 20000 to 29999.

subtype.description: The process is already listening on this port before the stack file is deployed.

authModes.description: none is the auth mode None. An export that says edgible-login is written org.

place.description: Topology name, not a device name and not a device id. Applications with the same place run on one serving device. Two applications that are one process share a place, a port, and a from.

memory.description: Memory for everything in the place together.

disk.description: Disk for the images and the data to start with.

arch.description: CPU architectures every image in the place runs on.

gpu.description: Whether the place needs a GPU.

runs.description: The Compose files this place runs. Required for a place no app uses: one that runs only services that connect out, such as a CI runner or a backup job. Such a place starts after Publish.

native.description: The place runs its app natively on this OS, not in Docker: install.sh installs a pinned release and starts it as a service, uninstall.sh removes everything it installed. For an app that needs the machine itself, such as Ollama on a Mac's GPU, which Docker on macOS cannot reach. A native place has no runs:.

class.description: irreplaceable: back it up and check it after a restore. rebuildable: the app recreates it from irreplaceable data, such as a search index. cache: safe to drop, such as thumbnails.

dump.description: A consistent copy without stopping the app. Without it, a consistent copy stops the app.

command.description: Run in service, it writes the dump to stdout.

restore.description: Run in service, it reads the dump from stdin.

command.description: Run with sh -c in service, with that container's environment.

service.description: A service in one of the card's Compose files.
